summary: Verified global colour-strength pass on .sect-*/.item-* tint classes, Contribution Estimator redesign (max-w-5xl + 8 coloured panels), and Carer self-assessment width bump (max-w-4xl). All computed rgba values match the spec (sect-teal 0.16, sect-clay 0.17, sect-sage 0.18). CE result section renders at 1024px, panels at 976px. cs1-assessment-root renders at 896px (max-w-4xl). Coloured panels clearly stand out from the beige canvas rgb(234,237,240) in light mode; dark mode uses solid dark-teal bg + gradient overlay + coloured inset accent — no dark-on-dark contrast failures. Text colour rgb(28,43,45) on light tints yields ~10:1 contrast (well above WCAG AA). All 8 CE data-testids (ce-result-headline solid teal + white, ce-govt-share-bar, ce-rate-breakdown, ce-safety-net, ce-oct-2026, ce-what-if, ce-also-worth-knowing, ce-how-calculated) present and correctly tinted. Screenshots visually confirm distinct section separation in both themes.

issues: Recharts console warning on mount: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (fires twice before ce-govt-share-bar pie renders). Chart still displays correctly. Consider giving the ResponsiveContainer parent a fixed height (e.g. h-40) or a minWidth/minHeight prop to silence the warning.

action_items: (Low priority polish) Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer sizing in ce-govt-share-bar pie to remove the 'width(-1)/height(-1)' console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Global tint values confirmed: light sect-teal/clay/sage = 0.16/0.17/0.18; item-teal/clay/sage = 0.12/0.14/0.15 — good hierarchy (item cards slightly softer than sect containers).

Dark mode sect-* panels all share the same solid bg rgb(14,48,51); differentiation relies on the linear-gradient overlay + inset accent stripe. That's intentional per code, and works visually, but colour-blind users may find the dark-mode differentiation subtler than light mode.
ce-result-headline uses bg-primary-k (solid teal) with white — high contrast, big weekly number is very legible.
